t: From CDN to Local: Managing JavaScript Dependencies in Pipulate Workflows
s: This article details the process of integrating the MarkedJS library into Pipulate by creating a Python script to download and locally store JavaScript dependencies, moving away from CDNs for enhanced workflow reliability.
sub: Pipulate workflow enhancement with code visualization widgets.
Local JavaScript dependency management via Python download script.
AI-assisted development strategy for workflow improvements.
Implementing MarkedJS for Markdown support in Pipulate.
